xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5015: Review verdicts are lost when GitHub returns 'Something went wrong' or 'non-200 OK status code: 502': the transient-error regex misses both

plan.title: Review verdicts are lost when GitHub returns 'Something went wrong' or 'non-200 OK status code: 502': the transient-error regex misses both
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: TRANSIENT_FORGE_ERROR in src/lib/forge-transient.ts misses GitHub's GraphQL 5xx message ('Something went wrong while executing your query') and gh's raw-5xx wording ('non-200 OK status code: 502 Bad Gateway'). isTransientForgeError therefore returns false, `pan admin specialists done review` does not journal review.verdict-deferred, and the verdict is lost (PAN-4956 and PAN-4960 approvals on 2026-11-04).
narratives.Proposal: Add the literal phrase 'something went wrong while executing your query' and a third anchored prefix 'non-200 OK status code: ' to the existing (?:failed: |HTTP )50[234]\b group. Prove it with forge-transient unit tests (both shapes transient; 404, 500 and a /pull/502 URL not transient) and two specialists-done tests showing a post failure with the GraphQL message and a lookup failure with the raw-502 message both journal review.verdict-deferred. Document both shapes in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No retry or deferral added to `gh pr merge` or `gh pr update-branch`; they do not call isTransientForgeError.
- No change to src/lib/cloister/deacon-api-recovery.ts (it classifies Claude API pane errors, not forge errors).
- No classification of HTTP 500 or bare 'Something went wrong' as transient.
- No bare 50[234] alternative outside the anchored prefix group.
- No change to retry delays (2 s / 8 s), the deferral cap (7) or the 10-minute replay cooldown.
- No changelog.mdx entry (written at release time).

autoDecisions.summary: Extend the anchored status group with 'non-200 OK status code: ' instead of adding a bare 502 alternative.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires keeping the anchoring that stops /pull/504 from matching; a third prefix preserves it.

autoDecisions.summary: Match the GraphQL error by the full phrase 'something went wrong while executing your query', not bare 'Something went wrong'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names this exact phrase; the bare phrase is generic enough to catch unrelated permanent failures.
The current regex excludes 500 and the issue's fix names 50[234]; GitHub's GraphQL 5xx is covered by the phrase match.

autoDecisions.summary: The merge and update-branch 502 failures cited in the issue are out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Fix section is regex plus tests; those paths never consult isTransientForgeError, so they need separate retry design.

metadata.sizeJustification: Three small items across one subsystem; no decomposition needed.

items.title: Classify GitHub GraphQL 'Something went wrong' and gh 'non-200 OK status code: 50x' as transient

expected_outputs: tests/unit/lib/forge-transient.test.ts passes including the new PAN-5015 strings

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/forge-transient.ts replace TRANSIENT_FORGE_ERROR (grep `const TRANSIENT_FORGE_ERROR =`) with /rate limit|secondary rate|abuse detection|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|ECONNREFUSED|socket hang up|timed out|something went wrong while executing your query|(?:failed: |HTTP |non-200 OK status code: )50[234]\b/i and update the doc comment above it to name the three prefixes and the GraphQL phrase (PAN-5015). In tests/unit/lib/forge-transient.test.ts add the five transient strings and three non-transient strings listed in the PRD, plus one exec-shaped stderr case with the GraphQL message. Change nothing else in production code.

items.title: Given the GraphQL message 'GraphQL: Something went wrong while executing your query on 2026-11-04T10:15:14Z. Please include `...` when reporting this issue.', when passed to isTransientForgeError as an Error, a string, or as stderr of an exec-shaped object, then it returns true
Given 'non-200 OK status code: 502 Bad Gateway body: "<html>..."' (and the 503 and 504 variants, and the same text after 'gh pr view <branch> failed: '), isTransientForgeError returns true

isTransientForgeError returns false for 'non-200 OK status code: 404 Not Found', 'non-200 OK status code: 500 Internal Server Error', and a message containing https://github.com/o/r/pull/502 with no 5xx text

Given the diff of src/lib/forge-transient.ts, it contains changes only to the TRANSIENT_FORGE_ERROR literal and its doc comment, and every 50[234] in the regex follows one of the prefixes 'failed: ', 'HTTP ', 'non-200 OK status code: '
Prove specialists done defers a verdict that hits GitHub's GraphQL 5xx or gh's raw 502

expected_outputs: specialists-done-forge-lookup.test.ts passes, including the two PAN-5015 cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. In src/cli/commands/__tests__/specialists-done-forge-lookup.test.ts add the two `it` cases from the PRD after the existing 'defers a verdict whose post hit a transient forge failure' case: (1) postReviewVerdict resolves { posted: false, reason: 'gh pr review failed: ...GraphQL: Something went wrong while executing your query...' } for status 'passed'; (2) discoverArtifact fails with 'gh pr view feature/pan-4222 failed: non-200 OK status code: 502 Bad Gateway body: "<html>"'. Keep lib/forge-transient.js unmocked so the real regex runs. Add a PAN-5015 line to the file header comment. Do not touch done.ts: the lookup error already carries gh's stderr in its message (src/lib/forge.ts line 189) and the post reason already carries stderr (pr-review-verdict.ts errorText).

items.title: Given postReviewVerdict returns posted:false with a reason containing 'GraphQL: Something went wrong while executing your query', when `doneCommand('review', ..., { status: 'passed' })` runs, then it exits 1, prints 'The verdict is saved and deacon-lite will retry recording it.', and appends exactly one review.verdict-deferred entry with status 'passed', the run id, and a reason containing the GraphQL phrase

Given discoverArtifact fails with 'gh pr view feature/pan-4222 failed: non-200 OK status code: 502 Bad Gateway ...', when the review verdict runs, then it exits 1, never calls postReviewVerdict, and appends one review.verdict-deferred entry whose reason contains 'non-200 OK status code: 502'
The test file does not mock '../../../lib/forge-transient.js', so both cases exercise the production regex; the cases fail when run against the pre-PAN-5015 regex
Document the GitHub 5xx shapes in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md

verify_commands: grep -n "Something went wrong while executing your query" docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md
expected_outputs: each grep prints exactly one line inside the 'Recording retries transient forge failures (PAN-4263)' paragraph

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3. In docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, in the paragraph beginning '**Recording retries transient forge failures (PAN-4263).**' (about line 749), after the sentence ending '(`lib/forge-transient.ts`).' insert: 'A 502/503/504 counts in any of gh's wordings (`HTTP 502`, `failed: 502`, `non-200 OK status code: 502`), and so does GitHub's GraphQL `Something went wrong while executing your query` (PAN-5015). A 500 does not.' Reflow only that paragraph. Do not edit changelog.mdx.

Given docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, the same paragraph contains the sentence that a 500 does not count as transient, and `git diff main -- docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md` shows changes only inside that paragraph
